# Agent Dump

> Agent Dump is a local command-line tool for finding, reading, exporting, and reusing AI coding conversations. Sources remain read-only. Supported tools include Codex, Claude Code, ZCode, Kimi, OpenCode, Cursor, Pi, DeepChat, Cherry Studio, and MiniMax Code. Formats vary by provider.

## Guides

- [All guides](https://agent-dump.xingkaixin.me/guides/): Practical workflows and commands.
- [中文使用说明](https://agent-dump.xingkaixin.me/zh/guides/): 六个场景的操作步骤、输出说明和限制。
- [Export Codex sessions](https://agent-dump.xingkaixin.me/guides/export-codex-session/): Find a URI, export Markdown or JSON, and copy the transcript into notes or another conversation.
- [Export Claude Code conversations](https://agent-dump.xingkaixin.me/guides/export-claude-code-conversations/): Save one or several local conversations.
- [Search coding history](https://agent-dump.xingkaixin.me/guides/search-ai-coding-history/): Full-text search, project filters, message locations, and cited excerpts.
- [Hand off context to an agent](https://agent-dump.xingkaixin.me/guides/handoff-context-to-ai-agent/): Reading prompts, bounded JSON pages, cursors, and revision handling.
- [Create work reports](https://agent-dump.xingkaixin.me/guides/weekly-report-from-ai-sessions/): Preview scope, configure AI collect, or generate a prompt for another agent.
- [Save to Obsidian](https://agent-dump.xingkaixin.me/guides/save-ai-conversations-to-obsidian/): Export Markdown into a vault with a dedicated output directory.

## Behavior boundaries

- Search and direct export operate locally without a model API key. AI collect sends selected conversation content to the configured model provider.
- --read-prompt and --collect --emit-prompt produce instructions; they do not launch another agent.
- Exported transcripts do not restore a running agent, its environment, or its execution state.
- Cursor supports JSON and print, not Markdown or raw export.

- [Project README](https://github.com/xingkaixin/agent-dump#readme): Installation, CLI parameters, provider capabilities, and configuration.
